subject: Q2 commit clarity — ownership and close-date accountability
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q2 commit clarity — ownership and close-date accountability

Team —

Finance asked for a quick, targeted sweep of opportunities that are currently in play for Q2 but have either: stale close dates (>30 days no change) or are sitting in mid stages with no clear next step. I ran a filtered export (attached) and flagged ~18 opps that need one of three actions:

- Update close date to a realistic target (if there is a committed timeline)
- Move to a non-commit stage (e.g., Negotiation -> Qualified) if we don’t have a firm decision timeline
- Mark as no-go / reclassify as no-decision if the customer has deprioritized

What I need from each of you: please triage the opps you own in the sheet and do one of the above by EOD Thursday (2027-03-04). Specific asks:

1) Update Salesforce close date and stage so Finance forecast reflects only realistic commit amounts.
2) If you need more time with customer, add a short comment on the HubSpot record and set a new close date — don’t leave the old date in place.
3) If you think an opp should remain in commit but you lack an explicit customer sign date, reply here with the short rationale and expected sign window.

I put a suggested action column in the Google Sheet (link below) and pre-populated recommended actions where the last activity was >45 days. If you disagree with an entry, overwrite it but add a 1–2 line justification.

Links / attachments:
- Q2 close-date triage (Drive): https://drive.google.com/open?id=Q2-close-date-triage
- Export: stale-opps-export.csv (attached)
- Commit checklist template (attached) — use if you plan to push the close date and need a 1-pager for customer confirmation.

I’ll consolidate changes on Friday morning and share a revised commit number with Finance. If you can’t complete the sweep by Thursday, let me know which opps you need help with and I’ll loop in solutions/CS.

Thanks — small, fast wins here help the forecast and reduce surprise adjustments.

Diego Fernandez
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 commit clarity — ownership and close-date accountability

Thanks Diego — I’ll take the list of opps where I’m listed as AE and update Salesforce by Thursday. Two quick notes:

- ACME-4592 (Sara Klein) — I have a calendar hold for the legal review on 3/10; recommend keeping as commit but moving close date from 3/4 -> 3/12 to reflect legal timing. I’ll add a HubSpot note and attach the draft SOW.
- ACME-4615 — customer has deprioritized; recommend reclassify to "no-decision" and move out of the commit column.

I updated the suggested-action column for both entries in the sheet.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales

Subject: Re: Q2 commit clarity — ownership and close-date accountability

Diego — appreciate the ping. Quick context on two of my opps:

- ACME-4592 — Grace is correct that legal review exists, but we still have a signed LOI and the customer verbally committed to a 3/4 deployment window. If we move the close date out to 3/12 we risk losing committed revenue in Finance's view; suggest we keep as-is until legal posts changes. I added a note on the HubSpot record with the LOI reference.

- CORP-3821 — this one is ambiguous; technical POC stalled. I’m proposing to move to "Negotiation" rather than commit. If Solutions can help re-engage this week, I’m happy to keep it open.

On timing: I can update my fields tonight. If Finance needs a hard decision earlier, we should flag ACME-4592 for leadership review rather than unilateral stage change.

Appreciate the quick replies and the context — this is exactly the level of detail Finance needs. Two small clarifications and next steps:

1) ACME-4592: leave in commit for now — Grace, please attach the draft SOW + legal calendar invite to the HubSpot record and set the close date to 2027-03-12 with a comment "legal review in flight; LOI signed; tracking for 3/12". Rishi, if legal publishes a redline or pushes, update immediately and flag me so we can decide whether to keep or move the revenue.

2) CORP-3821: Rishi — please move to Negotiation and set a task for Solutions to reach out by 3/05. I’ll loop in the Solutions lead in a separate note if you don’t hear back by EOD tomorrow.

3) Everyone: if you reclassify an opp to no-decision, add a one-line reason (customer deprioritized / no response / competing priority) in Salesforce and in the sheet so finance has the audit trail.

I’ll run a reconciliation script Friday morning and share the delta to Q2 commit. Thanks for turning this around fast — small hygiene updates reduce forecast noise more than you'd think.

Diego Fernandez
